audit_program:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=Path.cwd()
p=root/'runs/legal_openexempt_adaptive_legal_public_assets128_20261026_run01'
cfg=json.loads((root/'configs/openexempt_adaptive_legal_public_assets128_20261026_run01.json').read_text())
c1=json.loads((p/'candidates/b2_candidate1.json').read_text())
b1=json.loads((p/'publications/b1.json').read_text())
wire_path=p/'teacher/b2_candidate2/wire_request.json'
w=json.loads(wire_path.read_text());body=json.loads(w['user_prompt'])
assert c1['accepted'] and not c1['proposal_fully_committed']
assert c1['attempt_parent_bank_sha256']==b1['bank_sha256']
assert body['current_parent_library']==c1['candidate']
parent={(r['case_id'],r['family']):r for r in c1['actual_replay']}
proposed={(r['case_id'],r['family']):r for r in c1['proposed_replay']}
assert len(parent)==len(proposed)==64
assert {(c['source_case_id'],c['family']) for c in body['already_seen_training']}==set(parent)
checks={'actual_partial_parent_answers':0,'original_TRAIN_targets':0,'candidate_witness_answers_scores_and_raw_paths':0}
for c in body['already_seen_training']:
 key=c['source_case_id'],c['family'];r=parent[key];v=c['actual_parent_answer']
 assert v['executed_answer']==(r['parsed'] or {}).get('answer') and v['score']==r['score']
 assert v['source_model_emitted_evidence']['raw_call_path']==r['raw_call_path']
 target=json.loads((root/cfg['grading_directory']/f'{key[0]}.json').read_text())['targets'][key[1]]
 assert c['original_training_target']==target
 checks['actual_partial_parent_answers']+=1;checks['original_TRAIN_targets']+=1
feedback=body['rejected_candidate_feedback'];assert len(feedback)==1
f=feedback[0]
assert f['accepted'] and f['partially_committed'] and not f['proposal_fully_committed']
assert f['candidate_feedback_origin']=={'batch':2,'attempt':1,'current_committed_bank_sha256':c1['adaptive_commit_selection']['component_assessment']['bank_sha256']}
for v in f['feedback_witness_replay']:
 key=v['case_id'],v['family'];r=proposed[key]
 assert key in parent
 assert v['executed_answer']==(r['parsed'] or {}).get('answer') and v['score']==r['score']
 assert v['source_model_emitted_evidence']['raw_call_path']==r['raw_call_path']
 checks['candidate_witness_answers_scores_and_raw_paths']+=1
witnesses={(r['case_id'],r['family']) for r in f['feedback_witness_replay']}
references={(r['case_id'],r['family']) for r in f['feedback_reference_replay']}
assert references==witnesses and len(witnesses)==f['bounded_feedback_witness_task_count']==8
assert body['training_evidence_manifest']['all_bounded_feedback_witnesses_included']
assert wire_path.stat().st_mtime_ns>(p/'candidates/b2_candidate1.json').stat().st_mtime_ns
response=json.loads((p/'teacher/b2_candidate2/response.json').read_text())
assert response['model']=='gpt-5.6-sol' and response['cache_hit'] is False
all_source_ids={k[0] for k in parent}
for o in response['value']['operations']:
 assert set(o.get('source_case_ids',[]))<=all_source_ids
def compact(m):
 return {f:{k:v[k] for k in ('f1','full_output_f1','invalid_format','negative_or_unscored_asset_claims')} for f,v in m.items() if f in ('EC','EV')}
out={'at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'run_id':cfg['run_id'],
 'classification':'Actual B2 partial commit to next teacher feedback closure; not final B2 or TEST',
 'C1_selected':c1['adaptive_commit_selection'],'C1_actual_tokens':c1['actual_tokens'],
 'C1_global_gate_against_previous_parent':{k:v for k,v in c1.items() if k in ('accepted','current_family_nonregression','prior_family_nonregression','current_full_output_nonregression','prior_full_output_nonregression','current_negative_asset_and_format_nonregression','prior_negative_asset_and_format_nonregression')},
 'C1_full_proposal_failure':{k:v for k,v in c1['proposed_whole_bank_acceptance'].items() if type(v) is bool},
 'C1_actual_current_metrics':compact(c1['candidate_current']),'C1_actual_prior_metrics':compact(c1['candidate_prior']),
 'checks':checks,'feedback_witness_source_tasks':sorted([list(k) for k in witnesses]),
 'actual_C2_teacher_model':w['model'],'actual_C2_teacher_fresh':not response['cache_hit'],
 'actual_C2_teacher_prompt_characters':len(w['user_prompt']),
 'actual_parent_not_rejected_full_proposal_verified':True,
 'candidate_accepted_subset_and_unresolved_feedback_not_conflated':True,
 'original_TRAIN_labels_delivered_for_all_witnesses':True,
 'all64_real_parent_raw_answer_and_score_equal_original':True,
 'response_operations':[{'operation':o['operation'],'id':o.get('skill',{}).get('id'),'source_case_ids':o.get('source_case_ids',[])} for o in response['value']['operations']],
 'no_model_teacher_tokenizer_grader_or_solver_call_during_audit':True,
 'progress':json.loads((p/'progress.json').read_text())}
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
